expires.description: Expires is when this resource expires (RFC3339).

labels.description: Labels are arbitrary key/value pairs attached to the resource.

namespace.description: Namespace is the resource namespace (usually left blank).

revision.description: Revision is used for optimistic concurrency control.

spec.description: GithubConnector resource definition v3 from Teleport

api_endpoint_url.description: APIEndpointURL is the URL of the API endpoint of the Github instance this connector is for.

client_id.description: ClientID is the Github OAuth app client ID.

client_redirect_settings.description: ClientRedirectSettings defines which client redirect URLs are allowed for non-browser SSO logins other than the standard localhost ones.

allowed_https_hostnames.description: a list of hostnames allowed for https client redirect URLs

insecure_allowed_cidr_ranges.description: a list of CIDRs allowed for HTTP or HTTPS client redirect URLs

client_secret.description: ClientSecret is the Github OAuth app client secret. This field supports secret lookup. See the operator documentation for more details.

display.description: Display is the connector display name.

endpoint_url.description: EndpointURL is the URL of the GitHub instance this connector is for.

redirect_url.description: RedirectURL is the authorization callback URL.

teams_to_roles.description: TeamsToRoles maps Github team memberships onto allowed roles.

organization.description: Organization is a Github organization a user belongs to.

roles.description: Roles is a list of allowed logins for this org/team.

team.description: Team is a team within the organization a user belongs to.

user_matchers.description: UserMatchers is a set of glob patterns to narrow down which username(s) this auth connector should match for identifier-first login.
